paragraphs: The X-Type 2.0 V6 uses the AJ20 engine — a 2.0-litre V6 petrol unit derived from the Ford Duratec family. It was fitted from 2001 to 2009 across the X400 generation. A smaller displacement sibling to the 2.5 V6 (AJ25) and 3.0 V6 (AJ30), the 2.0-litre offers a smooth petrol alternative in a range otherwise dominated by diesel options. The X-Type is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Jaguar X-Type 2.0 V6 Engine Codes AJ20 A 2.0-litre V6 petrol engine fitted to the X-Type from 2001 to 2009 (X400). Known for ignition coil degradation over time — see the callout above. We replace ignition coils and valve cover gaskets as standard on every AJ20 rebuild. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the X-Type 2.0 V6 from 2023 to present. The engine features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older engine V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every engine rebuild.
